ideas.pitch: Computer-vision powered waste hotspot detection and municipal route optimizer for Jammu city.
ideas.title: JammuClean-AI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly tackles Jammu's sanitation priorities with a working live camera demo and clear municipal efficiency metrics, mirroring the pattern of practical civic impact seen in EcoSaathi.

ideas.pitch: Real-time flood and disaster response coordination dashboard for Jammu's Tawi river basin.
ideas.title: TawiCrisisSync
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages real-time alert mapping and multi-agency dispatch logic, highly relevant to Jammu's monsoon and geographical vulnerabilities, using the award-winning architecture of Oarfin and CrisisSync.

ideas.pitch: Geofenced offline-first immersive heritage storytelling app for the Mubarak Mandi palace complex.
ideas.title: MubarakMandak-AudioAR
ideas.why_it_could_win: Appeals directly to Jammu Smart City's tourism revitalization goals by enhancing local visitor experiences without requiring heavy infrastructure spending.

ideas.pitch: Low-bandwidth crowd-sourced public transport tracking and commuter dispatch for Jammu's congested routes.
ideas.title: JammuBusLive
ideas.why_it_could_win: Solves a daily commuter pain point with a functioning mobile prototype that judges can test live on their phones during judging rounds.

ideas.pitch: GIS-based urban canopy monitoring tool to track heat islands and plan green spaces across Jammu wards.
ideas.title: JammuGreenGrid
ideas.track: Urban Planning, Green Spaces & Public Realm
ideas.why_it_could_win: Empowers municipal planners with actionable spatial data and satellite overlay comparisons, proving immediate feasibility for city administrators.
